title: The capacitor supply chain bottleneck is becoming a bigger AI trade in the market
summary: The recent surge in stock market trades related to artificial intelligence (AI) has highlighted a significant bottleneck in the capacitor supply chain. This bottleneck is largely influenced by a few dominant Asian companies that have taken center stage in the market. As the demand for AI technologies escalates, the implications of this supply chain issue are becoming increasingly critical for investors and stakeholders alike.
